## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. What is the use case?

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## NVDA Parity Impact
**Critical**: This project maintains NVDA parity for non-Indian voices.
- Will this change affect synthesis output for non-Indian voices?
- If yes, is it gated behind an opt-in setting that defaults to OFF?
- Does it affect Indian voices differently?

## Scope
- [ ] UI / Settings
- [ ] Text preprocessing pipeline
- [ ] Voice data / pronunciation rules
- [ ] Native library (libespeak-ng)
- [ ] Build system
- [ ] Tests / CI
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional Context
- Mockups, sketches, or references to similar features in other TTS engines
- Relevant NVDA behavior (if applicable)
- Links to upstream espeak-ng issues/PRs if this requires core changes

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have considered NVDA parity implications
- [ ] This aligns with the project's goals (offline, accessible, NVDA-compatible)
